hero.title: Free cloud storage with no limit
hero.sub: Your files get locked on your own phone or laptop, then saved in accounts you already have, like Telegram or GitHub. Nobody else can open them. Not even us.
hero.micro: No card. No trial. There's nothing to upgrade to.
hero.capYou: <d>This is the app, with sample files. Click a file to open it, or drop one of yours on it.</d><t>Tap a file to open it, or tap + to add one.</t> Nothing leaves your browser.
hero.capThem: Same files, from our side. And from Telegram, GitHub, GitLab or Hugging Face: locked pieces called <nw>a3/9f04c1e2b7d8e1.bin</nw> in a project called <nw>quick-loader-v2</nw>. Nobody can open them. Not even us.
hero.osIos: Open in Safari, no app needed

footer.blurb: Free cloud storage that lives in accounts you already own. Locked on your device, so nobody else can open it. Not even us. Open source, and yours to run.
